fact: The Blade Bazaar is a sprawling marketplace in Gracklstugh named for the abundance of duergar goods, though it sells various other items as well.
source_quote: a sprawling marketplace named for the most abundant goods the duergar offered, though its stalls sold nearly everything a traveler could need
subject: Blade Bazaar

fact: The merchant initially hurled insults at customers until realizing Gyrgum intended to buy.
source_quote: a merchant who hurled insults at every customer until he realized they intended to buy
subject: Blade Bazaar merchant

fact: Upon deciding to make a sale, the merchant adopted an eerily posh accent resembling the Queen's English.
source_quote: the duergar adopted an eerily posh accent, much like the Queen's English
subject: merchant accent change

fact: The merchant offered a ten percent discount on a new mace in exchange for Gyrgum's old short sword.
source_quote: offered a ten percent discount on a new mace in exchange for Gyrgum's "rubbish" old short sword
subject: mace purchase offer

fact: Zalthir possesses a list of names he found while cleaning.
source_quote: Zalthir recalled a mysterious list of names he had found while cleaning
subject: list of names

fact: The names on the list are connected to people held as slaves by the drow, but it is unclear if they are slavers or family members.
source_quote: The individuals on it had some connection to the people held as slaves by the drow, though whether they were slavers or worried family members was unclear
subject: mysterious list

fact: One name on the mysterious list corresponds to a person currently located in Gracklstugh.
source_quote: one name corresponded to someone in Gracklstugh
subject: contact in Gracklstugh

fact: The party is concerned that revealing themselves as escaped drow captives could result in a bounty being placed on them.
source_quote: revealing themselves as escaped captives of the drow could put a price on their heads
subject: risk of disclosure

fact: Brannum Redmarch is a duergar who was previously held captive by the party and had plotted against them.
source_quote: turned to their captive, Brannum Redmarch, a duergar who had previously plotted against them
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: The party offered Brannum Redmarch his freedom in exchange for using his underworld connections to procure uncommon magical goods.
source_quote: They offered him his freedom in exchange for using his underworld connections to procure uncommon magical goods
subject: deal with Brannum

fact: Brannum Redmarch eagerly agreed to the deal offered by the party.
subject: Brannum's acceptance

fact: Hemeth was offended at being passed over for the procurement deal.
source_quote: Hemeth, deeply offended at being passed over, insisted on offering his own superior wares at a discount
subject: Hemeth

fact: Hemeth boasts that his handaxes are so well-made that they would be easily reused by whoever kills their owner.
source_quote: boasting that his handaxes were so well-made they would be easily reused by whoever killed their owner
subject: Hemeth's handaxes
